title: Lockheed Skunk Works and the UFO topic: Ben Rich, Rob Weiss, and the DeLonge emails

tellings.quote: Ben Rich who's the president of Skunk Works their most secretive division used to call UFOs unfunded opportunities

plain: Ben Rich, who ran Skunk Works, Lockheed Martin's most secretive division, used to call UFOs "unfunded opportunities", a phrase that would suggest the aerospace company saw the subject as a business to build. Michels tells it himself, pointing to emails of 2016 and 2017 that WikiLeaks published, involving Tom DeLonge and a man named Rob Weiss, as the trail that ties Skunk Works to the UFO topic.
